```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Purpose
Get HUD's Fair Market Rents for Oxford (ZIP 45056) from the HUD API. The token is stored as an environment variable, never in this file.

## Check the token is set (prints TRUE/FALSE, not the token)
```{r token}
readRenviron("~/.Renviron")
nchar(Sys.getenv("HUD_API_KEY")) > 0
```

## Request Butler County's Fair Market Rents
```{r request}
resp = httr2::request("https://www.huduser.gov/hudapi/public/fmr/data/3901799999") |>
  httr2::req_headers(Authorization = paste("Bearer", Sys.getenv("HUD_API_KEY"))) |>
  httr2::req_perform() |>
  httr2::resp_body_string() |>
  jsonlite::fromJSON()

names(resp$data)
```

## Keep Oxford's ZIP code and save
```{r oxford}
fmr_all = as.data.frame(resp$data$basicdata)
oxford_fmr = fmr_all |> dplyr::filter(zip_code == "45056")
oxford_fmr
readr::write_csv(oxford_fmr, "data/hud_fmr_45056.csv")
```
